#! -rules CONF-04 -strict
# The Snowflake layout with node and worker IDs (names, a tag and a TOML key), a hand-composed block ID,
# the retired 41/5/8/9 layout with a machine ID, and the Snowflake layout by multiplication (C++, Go).
# A shift through a name defined twice with different values (zone_ids.cpp; aa_bits.h sorts first) and
# through a sum of parenthesized constants (route_ids.cpp) is a block ID composed outside the minters.
# A line with two distinct violations (a node-ID name and a layout, or a name and its tag) has two findings.
# Shift amounts through a #define and a static const (define_ids.cpp), a parenthesized sum (paren_ids.cpp),
# an enumerator (enum_ids.cpp) and a braced constexpr (brace_ids.cpp).
